script.speaker: brooke
script.text: SEND-OFF DINNER for maya before the coast trip. all six of us, one table, first time ever. attendance is mandatory

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: i'm down. also i'm coming on the trip. i fit in a suitcase, i checked

script.speaker: maya
script.text: you'd eat all my snacks before the first rest stop. denied

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Maya, I've drafted your packing list. Item one: charger. Item two: the other charger.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: packing lists later. what are we EATING. i've been hungry since lunch

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ooh, the greek place from paddleboard night?? best night of the summer

script.speaker: liam
script.text: it was. but maya's about to live on fried fish off a pier for the whole trip. so tonight we send her off twirling pasta

script.speaker: maya
script.text: the trip's paid for, so tonight runs on the fun budget. the fun budget does nice. it does not do fancy fancy.

script.speaker: mina
script.text: can i ask for something again? somewhere with a few dishes to choose from with just veggies or tofu, no meat or fish :)

script.speaker: mina
script.text: maya, i painted you a tiny one of the boardwalk to take with you. so you don't forget us :)

script.speaker: maya
script.text: mina. i'm literally leaving this chat. to cry. in private

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: cyrus, you're off duty tonight. i'm the one keeping anything peanut, in any form, off our table. one satay incident per friendship is plenty

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Off duty. I'll try to remember what that feels like.

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Mostly off duty. Roxy, I've watched you order. You'll point straight at whatever comes buried in cheese or swimming in cream, and spend dessert doubled over.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...how do you KNOW that. fine. maya's night. i'll behave

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: confession: i planned this whole night eating crackers over my laptop. tonight i want a plate that's fresh and bright, not one more heavy thing

script.speaker: maya
script.text: you planned my send-off on CRACKERS?? brooke. tonight somebody feeds YOU

script.speaker: liam
script.text: seconds for brooke. thirds for me. it's only fair

script.speaker: maya
script.text: ok everyone stop being nice to me. it's a trip, not forever. i'm still going to miss you all

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: assistant, last dinner of the summer, all six of us. make it a good one
